name: Big room house (EDM festival)
lineage: Early-2010s house subgenre engineered for large festival main-stage performance contexts. Characterized by enormous-build-up-and-drop song-structure, simplified melodic and harmonic content, massive distorted-synth festival-anthem peak-sections, and predictable formulaic arrangement. Hardwell, Martin Garrix, Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike, and the Spinnin' Records-Revealed Recordings label rosters define the canonical sound. Tomorrowland, Ultra Music Festival, and EDC Las Vegas constitute the canonical festival circuit.
